nodes.description: governance address in StrategyBaseline; controls admin setters
controller address used for auth on withdrawals and vault lookups
underlying want token address held by the strategy
recv token address (e.g. crvREN pool token) set by SetRecv
fwant vault address for the want token
frecv vault address for the recv token
constant curve pool address used for liquidity operations
coin index inside the curve pool used by DepositToken/WithdrawToken
msg.sender; becomes governance in constructor and gates controller-only withdrawals
StrategyBaseline constructor assigns governance=msg.sender, controller, want
SetGovernance; only callable by governance
SetController; only callable by governance
SetRecv; fetches fwant/frecv from controller and validates non-zero addresses
deposit; converts want to recv then deposits recv into frecv vault
withdraw(IERC20 _asset); controller-only arbitrary asset rescue to controller
withdraw(uint256 _aw); controller-only, unwinds frecv vault and recv to satisfy want amount
withdrawAll; controller-only, unwinds everything and transfers want to fwant
balanceOf; computes total want value from frecv and recv holdings
DepositToken; approves curve and adds liquidity
WithdrawToken; removes curve liquidity and swaps other coins back into want coin
GetPriceE18OfRecvInWant; derives recv/want price from curve virtual price
StrategyBaselineBenzeneCurveREN constructor; sets index, want from curve coin, and recv
Address.sendValue low-level call forwarding all gas to recipient
Address._functionCallWithValue low-level call to arbitrary target with optional value
Vault(frecv).deposit external call executed after approvals
Vault(frecv).withdraw external call executed before want transfer
ICurveFiREN.add_liquidity external call with min_mint_amount 0
ICurveFiREN.remove_liquidity external call
ICurveFiREN.exchange external call with min_to_amount 0
IERC20.safeTransfer to controller or fwant, triggers token callback
_amount parameter of withdraw(uint256)
_asset parameter of withdraw(IERC20)
_index constructor parameter for the curve coin index
_w local want balance inside withdraw(uint256)
_ar local required recv amount inside withdraw(uint256)
_r local recv balance inside withdraw(uint256)
_af local required frecv amount inside withdraw(uint256)
_f local frecv balance inside withdraw(uint256)

edges.reason: constructor assigns governance = msg.sender, making the deployer the initial privileged account
SetGovernance requires msg.sender == governance before reassigning governance
SetController requires msg.sender == governance before reassigning controller
withdraw(IERC20) requires msg.sender == controller
withdraw(uint256) requires msg.sender == controller
withdrawAll requires msg.sender == controller
constructor writes controller from the deployment argument
constructor writes want from the deployment argument
SetGovernance overwrites the governance state variable
SetController overwrites the controller state variable
SetRecv reads controller to query vault addresses
SetRecv writes recv state variable
SetRecv writes fwant from Controller(controller).vaults(want)
SetRecv writes frecv from Controller(controller).vaults(recv)
deposit reads want balance before converting
deposit reads recv balance before vault deposit
deposit approves and targets frecv vault
deposit invokes DepositToken for positive want balance
deposit performs external Vault(frecv).deposit call after token approvals
withdraw(IERC20) forwards full asset balance to controller via safeTransfer
withdraw(uint256) reads want balance to compute shortfall
withdraw(uint256) reads recv balance
withdraw(uint256) reads and withdraws from frecv vault
withdraw(uint256) calls WithdrawToken to unwind recv
withdraw(uint256) performs external Vault(frecv).withdraw before final want transfer
withdraw(uint256) transfers want to fwant via safeTransfer after external unwinds
withdrawAll reads frecv balance
withdrawAll reads recv balance
withdrawAll reads want balance for final transfer
withdrawAll calls WithdrawToken to unwind all recv
withdrawAll performs external Vault(frecv).withdraw for full balance
withdrawAll transfers full want balance to fwant after external calls
balanceOf reads want balance
balanceOf reads recv balance
balanceOf reads frecv balance and priceE18
balanceOf calls GetPriceE18OfRecvInWant to value recv in want
DepositToken approves and calls the curve pool
DepositToken indexes the liquidity vector by index
DepositToken performs external ICurveFiREN.add_liquidity call
WithdrawToken approves and calls the curve pool
WithdrawToken uses index to pick the target coin
WithdrawToken performs external ICurveFiREN.remove_liquidity call
WithdrawToken performs external ICurveFiREN.exchange calls in a loop
GetPriceE18OfRecvInWant reads curve get_virtual_price
CurveREN constructor assigns index state variable
CurveREN constructor reads curve coins(_index) for want
CurveREN constructor calls SetRecv to configure recv/frecv/fwant
SetRecv indirectly triggers Controller vault lookups through low-level call helpers

normalization_plan.reason: _amount is only used to compute the want shortfall inside withdraw(uint256); it has no independent identity
_asset is only consumed for balance lookup and transfer inside withdraw(IERC20)
_index constructor parameter is immediately stored into the index state variable and used to derive want
_w is a transient want balance local with no cross-function meaning
_ar is a computed intermediate required recv amount local to withdraw(uint256)
_r is a transient recv balance local only used inside withdraw(uint256)
_af is a computed intermediate required frecv amount local to withdraw(uint256)
_f is a transient frecv balance local only used inside withdraw(uint256)
